rooms.alternativeDescription:
you slowly approach the humanoid figure as it says "Come on here, i am a human just like you." it sounds like it doesnt have emotion, as you approach you find it more and more scary, you grab a sharp glass shard from the ground.
 You slowly approach, you're about halfway through the room as the figure stops talking and only says one word "Come" You are almost there and the figure looks a bit clearer it looks more like yellow like skin hanging kinda loose from the body, buut most interesting, the eyes, they are glowing white.
You're so close and then, The figure lunges towards you and before you can react it grabs you by you're left arm and grabs youre right leg and start's trying to tear you apart, you firmly grip the glass shard and start stabbing it in its eyes, he lets out a really loud screech, as you keep stabbing him througout his entire face, he drops to the ground, you fall back onto the ground, the glass shard clatters out of youre hand, you look at his lifeless body laying on the ground, you stand up and try grabbing his body, you see that his skin comes off easily.
He was wearing a humans skin, you're scared hes gonna wake up again so you run towards the exit.
rooms.checkRoomMessage: You check the room! you see that the humanoid figure has slightly glowing eyes, the figure is saying "come here i am a human just like you"its seems to be talking without emotion.
